title: Verify every FW5 line citation in A001 STAGING-v4.md by computation
final_text:
Done. Summary of the work:

**Verified the source first:** `docs/sources/FW5-explanatory-construction.md` computes to sha256 `8105925b07db4a17f15c38cbad79aaca16653d94b0503de79756b5ece33ee63a` — matches the declared value.

**Method (script `check/verify_citations.py`):**
- Extraction regex: `\bFW5:(\d{2,4})(?:[-–](\d{2,4}))?|(?<![\d\w./-]):(\d{2,4})(?:[-–](\d{2,4}))?` — FW5-prefixed and bare colon forms, 2–4 digit numbers, hyphen or en-dash inclusive ranges; the bare-form lookbehind excludes sha256 fragments, times and file paths. Also written into both deliverables.
- Quotes from straight/typographic double quotes, backticks and `\( ... \)` on the same staging line are normalised (typographic quotes → straight, markdown emphasis stripped, whitespace collapsed) and substring-tested against the cited line/range under the same normalisation; fragments ≥12 chars only. Meta-citations (`:170 Their meanings…`), file paths, receipt field names and A001-written LaTeX are excluded from the quote test.

**Results (363 citations, 127 distinct targets):**
- CORRECT: 38 · CORRECT IN SUBSTANCE: 2 · NO-QUOTE-TO-CHECK: 243 · WRONG: 80
- No range has its end before its start.
- Blank cited source lines: 36, 38, 40, 42, 44, 46, 82, 175, 200, 207, 299, 643, 745, 788, 799, 801, 990, 996–1012 run, 1209, 1211, 1217, 1257, 1259, 1337–1343 odd lines, 1363, 1385 (display delimiters/section separators).
- The 80 WRONG rows are predominantly line-bundling artifacts: a staging line lists several citations (`:185, :194, :205` with a single quote to :188/:208, etc.) and the quote is tested against every citation on the line — each note shows the cited line's actual first 120 chars and the source line where the fragment actually sits (e.g. tag lines vs. content lines at :742/:743, :617/:620, :86/:106). Every WRONG verdict is backed by the cited line's actual text, per the no-WRONG-from-memory rule.

**Files written:** `check/verify_citations.py`, `out/citations-v4.json` (one object per citation: staging line, citation text, target lines, fragments tested, verdict, note), `out/citations-v4.md` (summary with counts, full WRONG list, blank lines, table of all 363).

**What the pattern would not catch** (also stated in the .md): one-digit references (`:7`), 5+-digit numbers, spelled-out citations ("line 208", "lines 613 to 618"), non-colon forms, and bare `:N` references that actually point at other files (e.g. a review file's `:299` — counted as FW5 because the pattern cannot see the intended file).
